source_refs: PO-OPPORTUNITIES-003.md: PO-003-1 assumptions and adversarial case
findings.finding: Mathematical containment does not establish language safety. Multiplication may overflow or narrow before accumulation; signedness, promotions, operand widths and evaluation order remain unknown. A 29-bit addition-first temporary is insufficient for 33M.
findings.required_action: For any later realization, analyze actual multiplication and intermediate types plus evaluation semantics; do not infer safety from MCU word size.

Nonnegative-domain square injectivity is essential. Current energy is excluded intentionally.

source_refs: PO-OPPORTUNITIES-003.md: PO-003-2 state bound and missing facts
findings.finding: At each fixed n>=32, arbitrary 31-tails can be reached using an n-31-length zero prefix followed by that tail. Claimed 4096^31=2^372 distinguishability concerns all retained information in the no-replay model. A 47-octet information payload excludes index/control/working storage and is not a target RAM footprint. External replay defeats application of this retained-state bound if left uncounted.
findings.required_action: Review actual permitted historical access and ownership before applying the lower bound. Do not infer 32 stored samples are necessary, full-interface sufficiency, or 2048-byte compliance.

findings.finding: Finite-state repetition is an appropriate prospective challenge to exact unbounded index generation when lambda depends only on finite Q and current input. Finite detector RAM alone does not close all information sources. No maximum epoch length follows from nominal 1 ms arrivals or optional resets. Potential full-interface interpretation gap remains conditional, not an unconditional AS defect.
findings.required_action: Keep closed-machine assumptions explicit. Later interface interpretation must resolve epoch/index/external-information scope without silently inventing a lifetime, wrap rule or index mechanism.
